name: bash-format
description: Auto-format shell scripts with shfmt once per batch of tool calls and again at git pre-commit, and check them with ShellCheck at commit, using the consuming repo's own .editorconfig and .shellcheckrc.

bash_format_enabled.title: Format shell scripts after edits
bash_format_enabled.description: After each batch of tool calls, run shfmt over the shell scripts it wrote, where the repository's .editorconfig opts in

bash_format_lint_gitignored.title: Act on files git ignores
bash_format_lint_gitignored.description: By default the hook leaves a file the repository gitignores alone: it is not rewritten or linted, since a rewrite of an ignored file has no git checkout to undo it. Set true to act on gitignored files too. A tracked file that matches an ignore pattern is always in scope.

bash_format_end_of_turn.title: Check shell scripts in uncommitted changes at turn end
bash_format_end_of_turn.description: At the end of each turn, run the pre-commit ShellCheck pass over the lines changed since the last commit and hand any findings back so they are fixed before the turn ends, at most once per turn. Nothing is rewritten. Off by default.
